create_zamba2_config: create a Zamba2Config instance with default model configuration parameters
initialize_zamba2_model: initialize a Zamba2Model from a Zamba2Config configuration object
configure_mamba_layers: configure mamba layer parameters including d_state, d_conv, expand, and ngroups
setup_hybrid_architecture: set up hybrid layer block types with mamba and transformer blocks for Zamba2
enable_long_context: enable long context mode by setting use_long_context to extend max_position_embeddings
